items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He always had great respect for Mona. In fact, he used to call her 'Mrs. Hinton.'

ctx.x: me." He'd really do that, man. He'd say, you know, "Great to see you." And his wife could do it, you know. But my wife... He always had great respect for Mona. In fact, he used to call her "Mrs. Hinton." He would never call her Mona. "Miz Hinton, would you take this lady, take this [it's a couple of hundred dollars], take her out and buy some nice things" -- because they would look a little shabby, you know.

There's nothing... I can't possibly, in any way... The most amazing man I ever worked with in my life was Louis Armstrong. To see him... To see the dedication. I don't know of anybody that was dedicated to music, to entertaining people as this man was. His whole being was to entertain and serve the public.
